Funding detail: UKRI rate (£21,805 per year) + £1,000 additional stipend enhancement

Basic Information

  • Full Programme Name: President's Doctoral Scholar Award
  • Host Institution: The University of Manchester
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 3.5 years
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: UKRI rate (£21,805 (2026/27 UKRI minimum) per year) + £1,000 additional stipend enhancement
  • Tuition Fees: Covered
  • Eligibility: Open to all nationalities
  • Application Deadline: Multiple rounds: November, January, March

Programme Description

The President's Doctoral Scholar (PDS) award is the University's flagship funding initiative. Each year the University awards the President's Doctoral Scholar Award to approximately three percent of research students who demonstrate academic excellence and leadership potential.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.presidentsaward.manchester.ac.uk/

Source: presidentsaward.manchester.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Manchester

The University of Manchester is a public research university in Manchester, England, and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across engineering, science, medicine, business and the humanities. Its research community connects academic discovery with challenges in health, sustainability, technology and society through collaboration.

Official website: https://www.manchester.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Apply to a PhD programme at Manchester and indicate interest in PDSA by the relevant funding deadline.
